Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Indian Standard

DIMENSIONS FOR PNEUMATIC RIVET 
SNAP SHANKS PARALLEL AND CHUCK BUSHINGS 

( First Revision ) 



1 . Scope — Covers the dimensions of pneumatic rivet snap shanks parallel and fitting dimensions of 
related chuck bushings.

3. Designation — A pneumatic rivet snap shank, parallel having nominal size 23 and length / = 65 
mm shall be designated as: 

Rivet Snap Shank Parallel 23 X 65 IS : 6574 



EXP LAN ATORY NOTE 

This standard was first issued in 1972, based on Draft ISO Recommendation DR 1216, which 
has now been finalized as ISO 1180-1983. 

This standard does not deal with light rivet snap shanks {that is, nominal sizes 10 to 17), 
These are covered in IS : 6572-1987 'Dimensions for pneumatic light rivet snap shanks and its chuck 
bushings'. 

While revising, this standard has been aligned with ISO 1 1 80-1 983 'Shanks for pneumatic tools 
and fitting dimensions of chuck bushings', issued by the International Organization for Standardiza- 
tion (ISO). 



Adopted 1 May 1987
